wc.text: On September 2, 2026, we completed the acquisition of 100% of the equity interests of Serpentix Conveyor, LLC (“Serpentix”), a Westminster, Colorado-based manufacturer of engineered conveyor systems used primarily in municipal wastewater treatment plants and industrial manufacturing facilities, for a purchase price of approximately $51.5 million, subject to a post-closing adjustment based on changes in net working capital. Serpentix is included in the Precast segment for all periods following the acquisition date. This acquisition complements our existing dewatering, separation, and mixing capabilities, broadens the solutions we can provide to municipal and industrial customers, and advances our strategy to expand our presence across essential water and wastewater infrastructure markets.

Water Transmission Systems.text: Under the Northwest Pipe Company brand, we are the largest manufacturer of engineered water transmission systems in North America and produce steel casing pipe, bar-wrapped concrete cylinder pipe, and pipeline system joints and fittings. We also provide solution-based products for a wide range of markets including high-quality reinforced precast concrete products, lined precast sanitary sewer system structures, water distribution and management equipment including pump lift stations, wastewater pretreatment and conveyor systems, and stormwater quality products. Strategically positioned to meet growing water and wastewater infrastructure needs, our skilled team is committed to quality and innovation while upholding our core values of accountability, commitment, and teamwork. Headquartered in Vancouver, Washington, we operate 15 manufacturing facilities across North America.

intro.text: Founded in 1966, NWPX Infrastructure, Inc. is a leading manufacturer of water-related infrastructure products. Under the Northwest Pipe Company brand, the Company is the largest manufacturer of engineered water transmission systems in North America and produces steel casing pipe, bar-wrapped concrete cylinder pipe, and pipeline system joints and fittings. The Company also provides solution-based products for a wide range of markets including high-quality reinforced precast concrete products, lined precast sanitary sewer system structures, water distribution and management equipment including pump lift stations, wastewater pretreatment, and stormwater quality products. The Company has broadened its manufacturing footprint by bringing lined and engineered precast products into production at additional facilities. This increases the Company’s capacity and improves regional availability.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Wages, services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Short-term debt and commercial paper
lines.why: Borrowed money: financial.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Finance lease liabilities
lines.why: Leases that work like a loan for the asset: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: We currently conduct a significant portion of our precast and reinforced concrete products business in Texas and Utah, which we estimate represented approximately 42% and 52%, respectively, of Precast net sales for the year ended December 31, 2025.

As of December 31, 2025 , no customer had a balance in excess of 10% of total accounts receivable, and one customer had a balance in excess of 10% of total accounts receivable as of December 31, 2024 .
No WTS customer accounted for more than 10% of total net sales for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 .
One WTS customer accounted for 10% of total net sales for the year ended December 31, 2023 .
No Precast customer accounted for more than 10% of total net sales for the years ended December 31, 2025 , 2024 , and 2023 .
